column5: The newly-added Wedding Date Search field should be surfaced in Pipeline, Deployments, and Recap views, not only where it currently lives.
column6: Wedding Date filtering was not consistently available across the requested interfaces. Pipeline could support the same filtering pattern already used in Alterations, but Appointments and Recap operate as single-day views: applying a Wedding Date filter on top of the selected appointment day would typically return little or no useful data, since a client’s appointment date is unrelated to their wedding date.
column7: For Appointments and Recap (single-day views), filtering by Wedding Date against the day currently shown returns almost no results. Two options: (A) keep the filter scoped to the selected day as-is, accepting it will rarely show anything, or (B) when Wedding Date filter is active, temporarily switch the view to show matching clients across all days instead of just the selected one. Which do you prefer for these two pages?
